description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for managing booking status tabs, including logic for determining the correct tab based on booking data, and handling navigation to the appropriate tab based on pre-selected booking info.

methods.name: getTabForBooking
methods.description: Determines the appropriate booking tab based on booking status, end time, and recurring event ID.

methods.name: useSwitchToCorrectStatusTab
methods.description: React hook that switches to the correct booking status tab based on pre-selected booking data and URL.

methods.name: usePreSelectedBooking
methods.description: React hook that fetches and returns pre-selected booking data based on URL query parameters.
